claims.note: Supported by F-M02 examples; no general rate claimed.

claims.text: Runs used LLMiser's recognition code with its production English model on a local machine, not the live service
Empty image returns 'No text detected in this image'; failed PDF page gets a page warning; empty native run returns 'No extractable text found in this document'
Recognized pages start with <!-- page N: text recognition -->; text and blank pages carry no label; up to 100 scanned pages per PDF with a warning listing the rest
LLMiser checks orientation only when its first read looks weak
LLMiser enlarges small images to twice their size, boosts contrast, renders scanned PDF pages at 200 dpi
claims.note: 2x only when long side under 1,000 px and within the 12 MP target.

claims.text: In the mixed PDF the blank third page added the 'No extractable text' line at the end
The 90-degree copy read confidently, no rotation ran, text in order, Qty column kept
Clean scan: 7-pt terms line exact; degraded: 'Terme not DO A late fee of 1:5 per mance appten ater 2006-0517'
Degraded copy turned 10.50 into '40. 50' and separated amounts from item names
Clean scan read 'PO 10O5-B' as 'PO 1005-B'; 'L5' became 'LS'; 'C0O1-7781' read correctly
Recognition cannot settle whether 03/04/2026 is March 4 or April 3
Two-column page came back in order, left five then right five
Degraded invoice labels appeared in one block with values several lines later
Clean upright invoice lost the Qty column and header with no warning
claims.note: Local tesseract 5.3.4; production binary may differ.
